lines: 001 · Forking Yours Wallet onto phones: how bWalletX started, and why we left the Yours code alone.
002 · Four names in a week: Yours Wallet Mobile, bCorp Wallet, bWallet, then bWalletX. Why the name kept changing, and why there are now two apps.
003 · Tabs, apps and a social feed: The phone layout changed many times. We added an Apps home screen with 100+ BSV apps, a Media player and a feed that reads other BSV social apps.
004 · Names, handles and paymail: Send to $handle, name@bwalletx.com or an OpNS name. The paymail server moved domain twice, and social sign-in became a verified name.
005 · Personal tokens and token rooms: Hold a token to enter its chat room. Your $NAME is a token with its own room. How rooms, tickets and issuers came together, and what we reversed.
006 · Who pays for indexing: A BSV-21 token only shows up in wallets once an indexer lists it. Working out who pays for that, and how much, took four attempts.
007 · Store rules, open rooms and moderation: We audited the app against App Store and Play rules, split it into four release channels and built the safety features the stores require.
008 · Building the Exchange, and why buys broke: Listing and buying 1Sat tokens from the wallet. Most of the work was not the screens but storage limits, double-encrypted records and slow APIs.
009 · The b agent: paid, or your own key: An assistant inside the wallet. It started free, became paid-only within a day, and now asks for consent before it sends anything.
010 · Agent accounts, strategies, CLI and MCP: Separate wallet accounts for agents, spending rules the wallet enforces, a market for strategies, and a command-line tool that keeps keys on the phone.

011 · From a dollar bond to PNEEs on mainnet: A BSV-backed dollar token went from a design note to a small, capped mainnet pilot in two days. This is what is enforced, what is not, and what went wrong.

012 · The extension, the web app and pairing: bWalletX also runs as a Chrome and Brave extension and as a web app. On iPhone the web app is the only way to get the full wallet, so we made backup mandatory there.
013 · Two sites from one: A download page became bwallet.space, then bwalletx.com became the main site, with the store site generated from it. And this blog.
014 · One feed for BSV: Every BSV social app keeps its own feed. bChat shows all of them, credits them, and pays the people who wrote the posts.
018 · 1 BSV for testing bWallet on Android: Google needs 12 people to test bWallet for 14 days before it can go on the Play Store. We are paying 1 BSV for that time.
021 · Coordinate on BSV: Big platforms put every community in one room, where a small one gets piled on. Advertise there, coordinate here. Part 1 of a series on chat on BSV.
022 · Bring your coins home: your old 12 words still work. Which BSV wallets bWalletX can restore or sweep from, and what can't come across.
024 · Pay the person who wrote it: in bWalletX a paid like or a tip pays the author in the same transaction. bChat takes 0%, the post's home app gets 5% on top, and authors can hide their own posts.
025 · Push notifications, from our own server: DMs, mentions and calls in bWalletX via push.bwalletx.com. Previews off by default, no message text stored, and why we didn't use a third party.
026 · Paying to be heard: token rooms in bWalletX can charge per message, burned or paid to the issuer. The wallet signs, the server checks, then it's spent. No paid-but-refused. Admins exempt.
015 · Launchpad, and checking what we sign: bWalletX 5.1.74 can buy and sell bonding-curve coins. The wallet now checks every trade the server prepares before it signs anything.
016 · Subscriptions, paid from pots: Subscriptions in bWalletX are paid from a pot, money you set aside for them. Out now in 5.1.75 at Settings › Pots. Free, and you can pause any time.
017 · Sign in with bWalletX, and the Lounge: bChat now has one gold button to sign in with your wallet. Every account starts in the bWallet Lounge.
019 · Blur slurs, show swearing: The bChat feed and bWalletX now blur slurs behind a tap. Swearing is shown. Nothing is deleted.
020 · Sign in with X: bWalletX can make a wallet from your X account. You get your X username as a verified paymail, b0asex.x@bwalletx.com for example, with your picture, a token and a room.
027 · Airdrops, not dividends: why bWalletX issuers reward holders with airdrops, a filter that blocks returns wording, an airdrop inbox, and sandboxed NFT content.
028 · Launch something with your coin: token links for a website, app, X, Telegram and bChat. Holding gets you the room; anything else is "Issuer says". No company field.
029 · bPositive: sponsor someone's journey in bWalletX. Monthly support from pots, milestone pledges confirmed by witnesses, thank-you NFTs. Gifts only, 18+, 0% fee. Coming.
030 · bPhone: charge to receive calls in bWalletX. Set a price per second, minute, hour or call, paid wallet to wallet while you talk, with no middleman.
031 · bWalletX 5.1.88 is out: a Calls tab with Recents, Contacts, Services and a keypad, mics and cameras that work in Spaces and calls, up to 4 accounts in the menu, sign-in alerts.
032 · Meet bChatX: chat's new home. Sign in with bWalletX, your wallet stays bWalletX, the feed arrives with the page, and posts from other apps are filtered.
033 · Spaces you can just listen to: public Spaces on bChatX need no sign-in to listen. Up to 12 speakers on stage, and a relay so office and hotel networks can join.
034 · Open apps, open protocol: MIT-licensed apps, the bChat Protocol on GitHub, a proposal for threads across apps. Your keys never leave your wallet.
035 · Pots & Locks: the Lock screen groups your locks into pots like Pension and Savings goal, every lock feature kept, and a PNEEs pot for BSV locked to back PNEEs.
036 · Subscriptions priced in dollars, paid in BSV at that day's rate, from a pot you choose. One list, Pause all, cancel any time. Nothing paid up front.
037 · Portfolio vs market: tap the price tile to see your wallet against just holding BSV, holding BTC or keeping dollars, over a day, week, month, year or all time.
038 · Swap into BSV: BTC, ETH and 1,000+ coins into BSV from the home screen. ChangeNOW runs the swap and the BSV comes straight to your own wallet.
